rv.q: Beyond the feats of focus and memory, interpretation of the bard is captivating.
Adapted by Eddie Izzard’s sibling Mark Izzard, this “Hamlet” is among the best “Hamlets” on stage, screen, or stream.

cn.t: Eddie Izzard's solo performance of all 23 characters in Hamlet earns strong praise from critics, who appreciate the skillful one-person interpretation that balances Shakespeare's tragedy with moments of wit.
